name: Artistic Talent
body:
Prerequisites: 10 Charisma.

Benefit: A rogue with this talent selects one spell from the 0-level bard spell list. she may use this spell three times per day as a spell-like ability, using her rogue level as her caster level. The DC for this spell is equal to 10 + the rogue’s Charisma modifier.
